_notes: 마감 is used for both a Hangyul task's due date and a university's closing date. Where the key clearly concerns applications (today.closingV4, v30.def.ops.deadlines, login.p2Text) I wrote 'application deadline' per the glossary; students.deadlineShort and today.deadlines are ambiguous and were left for the owner.

단계 was rendered as 'phase', 'step', 'process' and 'stage' across the agency console; unified on 'stage' (glossary: current stage). The university funnel keeps 'step' because a funnel step is a different concept from a case stage.
대학 서류 요청 / 대학이 서류 추가 요청 appeared as 'asked for', 'asks for', 'requested'; unified on 'requested' to match the status name 'Documents requested'.
공증·인증 means notarization AND legalization; 'Legalization' alone dropped half the meaning. 아포스티유·영사확인 is 'apostille or consular legalization' (glossary).
모집요강 확인 is the Hangyul HQ verification of an admission guide; 'review' was replaced with 'verify' to match 'Admission guide not verified'.
상담 = consultation (never counseling); 면접 연습 = mock interview; 표준입학허가서 = standard admission letter; 서비스 기간 = service period (not term); 기숙사 = dormitory (not dorm) in console copy.
답장 대기 / 응답 대기 chips were 'Waiting' or 'Waiting for your reply'; in the consoles 'waiting on' names a party, so the chip became 'Reply owed' (the V9 reason code reply_owed).
불합격 in closed-count labels was 'rejected'; the status both consoles show is 'Not admitted', so the labels now say 'not admitted or withdrawn'.
University console contractions (aren't, hasn't, you're) were expanded only in explanatory sentences, to keep the formal register; short UI labels were not touched for this reason alone.
